landing.heroSubtitle: Customer feedback, transparent roadmaps, and shipped changelogs in one calm home.
landing.storyLead: When teams collect ideas but never follow up, customers stop contributing. UserHQ connects every stage of product planning directly to public delivery.
landing.step1Desc: Scattered Slack messages, emails, and support tickets make customer demand impossible to quantify. UserHQ unifies incoming requests into a single, clean community board where users upvote existing ideas instead of filing duplicates.
landing.step1Feature1: Single sign-on via Google & GitHub for authentic user votes
landing.step1Feature2: Custom categories to segment requests by product area
landing.step1MockTitle: Webhook notifications for post status changes
landing.step1MockMeta: Requested by 12 teams · Status updated to Planned
landing.step2Title: Plan with clarity on the roadmap
landing.step2Desc: Bridge user demand with engineering reality. Move top-voted ideas onto your Kanban roadmap so customers can follow progress without cluttering your private sprint boards.
landing.step2Feature1: Kanban lanes configured to match your development cycle
landing.step2Feature2: Public roadmaps stay sanitized while internal discussions remain private
landing.step2MockTitle: Keyboard shortcuts for rapid backlog triage
landing.step2MockMeta: Assigned for Q4 2026 delivery · Linked to 62 community voters
landing.step3Desc: When work is done, publish changelog notes with rich text and images. Every customer who voted for or commented on the feature is notified automatically, proving their voice matters.
landing.step3Feature1: Rich-text release notes with image attachments
landing.step3Feature2: Automated email notifications to release subscribers
landing.step3MockMeta: All 84 voters notified: "A feature you requested is now live!"
landing.foundationsHeading: Built for clarity, trusted by your customers.
landing.foundationsDesc: Designed with quiet restraint so your product and your customers remain the focus.
landing.brandFirstDesc: Custom brand logos, tailored accent colors, and unique workspace slugs make portals feel like native parts of your application.
landing.publicTransparencyDesc: Customers see clear, curated roadmaps and release updates while internal estimation, draft statuses, and member permissions stay safe in your team dashboard.
landing.ctaBody: Built with care by Increasing Labs. Have an invite link? Sign in to get started. Want access for your team? Contact hello@increasinglab.com.
landing.setupWorkspaceDesc: A workspace holds your products, your team, and the portals your customers visit.
landing.inviteOnlyDesc: UserHQ is invite-only for now. If someone gave you an invite link, open it while signed in with the email it was created for.
landing.reachOutTo: Reach out to Increasing Labs to request early access for your team.
